content: This paper presents a new methodology for simultaneously selecting features and classifying functional data in healthcare applications, particularly for longitudinal data from wearable devices and sensors with categorical outcomes. The approach uses an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm combined with functional principal components to efficiently handle high-dimensional datasets, and is validated through simulations and real-world analysis of chronic disease relationships with health and socio-demographic factors.
